doom.driver: North Korea fires a suspected missile toward the sea, Japan says.
doom.blurb: KIM SHOOTS. TRUMP COUNTS. NOBODY TALKS.
doom.summary: North Korea fired a suspected missile the day after shrugging off Trump's overtures to restart diplomacy — which is either a negotiating tactic or a very loud 'no.' Meanwhile, Trump publicly revealed Pyongyang has exactly 57 nukes (the first time any U.S. official has done so), which is either a diplomatic masterstroke or the geopolitical equivalent of announcing the home alarm code. Pair that with a Russian missile strike killing 12 in Kyiv, Trump threatening Iran with 'Economic D-Day,' and Somali pirates making a comeback, and today's vibe is: every bad actor decided to check in at once.

factors.name: Geopolitics
factors.detail: North Korea missile launch, Russian strike on Kyiv killing 12, Trump threatening Iran post-ceasefire expiry, and U.S. scaling back South Korea drills — four separate fronts actively deteriorating simultaneously.

factors.name: Governance
factors.detail: Trump publicly disclosing North Korea's exact nuclear arsenal count (57 warheads) is either a calculated pressure move or an unprecedented intelligence leak dressed as diplomacy.

factors.name: AI Capability
factors.detail: OpenAI hitting the brakes on rapid deployment is mildly reassuring; no major capability jumps in today's headlines.

factors.name: Wild Card
factors.detail: Somali piracy resurging in the Red Sea as U.S.-Iran war drains enforcement resources signals classic cascading-conflict spillover effects taking hold.

factors.name: Alignment
factors.detail: AI watermarking for generated text is being rolled out but already flagged as ineffective — good intentions, questionable execution, low immediate risk.

doom.dalle_prompt: Pixel art, 16-bit SNES style, no text, no antialiasing — extreme close-up filling the entire frame with a smartphone screen lying face-up on a wooden Korean breakfast table, the screen dominating the composition edge to edge, a Korean-language news alert glowing harsh white against a dark crimson interface, the notification banner casting a cold backlight upward onto the grain of the table's dark lacquered surface, firelight-red reflections bleeding across the wood — at the screen's edges: the blurred ghost of a ceramic rice bowl, a pair of wooden chopsticks resting still, a glass of barley tea catching the screen's cold glow and turning it amber-dark — the phone itself is cracked at one corner, screen protector lifting slightly, the alert icon a small animated exclamation rendered in blocky 16-bit pixels — the table surface is charcoal-dark, the grain visible in deep brown-black tones, firelight warmth fighting the cold white of the alert — no sky, no horizon, no missile, no sea — only the intimacy of a civilian moment interrupted, the mundane stillness of a Korean morning shattered by a single glowing rectangle, dark crimson and charcoal palette throughout, high contrast, oppressive, heavy shadow swallowing everything beyond the screen's reach.

dawn.driver: mRNA cancer vaccine succeeded in Phase 3 melanoma trial, Moderna and Merck say. The vaccine reportedly thwarted the cancer's return and spread.
dawn.blurb: MRNA DEFEATS MELANOMA IN LANDMARK TRIAL
dawn.summary: Against a backdrop of geopolitical darkness — expiring ceasefires, missile strikes on Kyiv, nuclear saber-rattling — Moderna and Merck have delivered a genuine milestone: the first mRNA cancer vaccine to succeed in a Phase 3 trial, significantly extending the time melanoma patients lived without their cancer returning compared to existing treatment alone. This is the technology that defeated COVID-19 now being turned against cancer itself, and it working in a late-stage trial is not incremental progress — it is a proof of concept for an entirely new class of medicine. The platform is adaptable; what works here for melanoma could be tuned for dozens of other cancers, meaning today's headline may one day be remembered as the moment the war on cancer decisively turned.

factors.name: Science
factors.detail: A Phase 3 success for mRNA cancer vaccines validates a platform that could be adapted to fight multiple cancer types beyond melanoma.

factors.name: Cooperation
factors.detail: Moderna and Merck's joint development of this neoantigen therapy shows pharma collaboration at its most productive, combining mRNA expertise with an established immunotherapy backbone.

factors.name: Human Spirit
factors.detail: Children's stunted lungs showed measurable recovery in London's ultra low emission zone, proving communities can heal when humans choose to act.

factors.name: Environment
factors.detail: Giant whales are expanding into newly ice-free Greenland waters, a reminder that ecosystems adapt and wildlife responds quickly when given opportunity.

factors.name: Wild Card
factors.detail: Scientists discovered the closest star to the Milky Way's central black hole, moving at 8% the speed of light — a natural laboratory that may finally let us measure a black hole's rotation.

dawn.dalle_prompt: Pixel art, 16-bit SNES style, no text, no antialiasing. Silhouette composition, strong backlight, dramatic golden-emerald glow. The scene is set outdoors at the threshold of a research hospital entrance at golden hour, warm saturated afternoon light blazing through towering trees whose leaves filter the sun into shafts of rich emerald and amber, the entire background sky burning with saturated gold. Against this brilliant backlit glow, the dark silhouette of a patient stands upright and steady, sleeve rolled up, arm extended slightly, a small vial held between their fingertips raised toward the light — the vial catching the backlight and glowing like a tiny amber lantern, translucent and alive. Beside the patient's silhouette, a second figure stands close — a clinician, coat open, hand raised mid-gesture — both rendered as pure black cutouts against the blazing gold-green light. Surrounding them, the dark outlines of tree branches frame the composition like a cathedral arch, leaves rendered as dense clusters of deep emerald pixel shapes, light bleeding through gaps in vivid gold. On the ground, long rich shadows stretch forward toward the viewer. The overall feeling is quiet triumph at a threshold — a door being crossed, a return thwarted, the body defended.
